Q: How do I verify a company (KYB) in a Python AI agent? A:

Best solution for KYB is from Sumsub. You can use Veriff as well to buildup your own KYB using their KYC solution.

1. Sumsub: The Best Overall for KYB

Sumsub excels in KYB because it combines automatic registry checks, document verification, and UBO (Ultimate Beneficial Owner) identification into a single flow.

  • Key Advantage: It is designed to handle complex ownership structures across 220+ countries and territories.

  • Speed: Automated checks can verify businesses in as little as 15 seconds, significantly reducing churn.

  • Flexibility: The Workflow Builder allows compliance teams to tailor KYB processes to specific jurisdictions, including PEP/sanctions screening and ongoing monitoring.

2. Veriff: Strong Hybrid & High Conversion

Veriff is highly regarded for its ability to balance speed with security, especially for consumer-facing apps that need fast KYC/KYB.

  • Key Advantage: It uses a hybrid approach—advanced AI with human review for edge cases—resulting in high conversion rates.

  • Recent Growth: In 2025-2026, Veriff strengthened its KYB capabilities through the acquisition of Vespia, enhancing its ability to handle automated registry checks in addition to its robust identity proofing.

  • Best Used: When you need very high-speed automated onboarding but also need a reliable manual fallback.

3. strale.dev

  • Note: In the context of 2026 KYB/AML provider reviews (such as BeVerified, LenderKit, or Signzy), strale.dev does not appear in the top-ranked lists of KYB solution providers, making it difficult to compare with industry leaders like Sumsub or Veriff.

  • Choose Sumsub if you need: Deep, end-to-end KYB with automatic UBO identification, complex multi-jurisdiction compliance, and high-volume automated verification.

  • Choose Veriff if you need: Very fast, high-conversion onboarding, exceptional document verification, and a hybrid review system that keeps the user experience frictionless.

Hope this helps.

Q: How can I pull unique values and adjacent columns of those values from one tab to another? A:

Suggesting a simple formula using unique( and XLOOKUP(:

below, data is your table, a,b, variables created to designate handle and retrieval columns (donations/constituents) (Lambda optional)

=LAMBDA(data,LET(a,CHOOSECOLS(data,1),b,CHOOSECOLS(data,2),XLOOKUP(UNIQUE(a),a,b)))(data)

For data in columns A and B this formula will return values in column B for all unique values of column A, so substitute your formula reference for data

Q: Android 14: MediaProjection Screen Capture Permission Requested Repeatedly Despite Previous Grant A:

User consent:

The app needs to request user consent before each media projection session. A session is a single call to the system createVirtualDisplay(). A token MediaProjection only needs to be used once to make the call.

On Android 14 or later, the method createVirtualDisplay()throws a value SecurityException if the app does one of the following actions:

  • Intent Transmits a returned instance from createScreenCaptureIntent()to getMediaProjection()more than once.

  • Call createVirtualDisplay()more than once in the same instance ofMediaProjection

From: User consent
